北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，但体感 -7℃ 很冷哦，多穿点！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is clear but feels very cold at -7℃. Bundle up!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾体感 2℃，注意行车安全，别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy and feels like 2℃. Drive safely and stay warm.
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天体感 3℃，湿度高，出门记得带伞。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels like 3℃, high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴好，体感 14℃ 挺舒服，注意多喝水。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and a pleasant 14℃. Stay hydrated!
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天体感 18℃，温度适中，保持好心情。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 18℃. Pleasant weather, enjoy your day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天体感 1℃ 偏冷，出门添衣防寒。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels cold at 1℃. Wear more clothes to stay warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾体感 1℃，能见度低，出行务必小心。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is very foggy and feels like 1℃. Low visibility, please be careful when traveling.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天体感 3℃，微凉，记得添件衣服。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and a bit chilly at 3℃. Remember to add a layer.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾体感 -1℃，又湿又冷，注意保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy and feels like -1℃. It's damp and cold, stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗体感 0℃，气温低，注意防寒多饮水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear but feels like 0℃. It's cold, stay warm and hydrate.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾体感 6℃，出行注意安全，当心着凉。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and feels like 6℃. Drive safely and avoid catching a cold.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒 -22℃，大雾，全副武装注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold at -22℃ with fog. Bundle up completely to avoid frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳大雾体感 -20℃，请务必多穿，注意防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is very foggy and feels like -20℃. Please dress warmly and stay safe from the cold.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 7℃ 昼夜温差大，早晚添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear, feels like 7℃. Large temperature difference, add layers in mornings/evenings.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天体感 17℃，湿度高，出门心情美美哒。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and feels like 17℃. High humidity, enjoy your day!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云体感 -5℃，风力大，外出注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels like -5℃ with strong winds. Protect from wind and stay warm outdoors.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾体感 -8℃，湿冷，出行注意保暖安全。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy and feels like -8℃, damp and cold. Stay warm and safe while traveling.
